description: AI command generation uses Ollama first with OpenRouter fallback and deterministic failover behavior

requirements.description: Go API endpoint accepts prompt + terminal context and returns generated command suggestion. Provider chain executes Ollama first, falls back to OpenRouter on failure.

validation.notes: Test provider failover logic (TestAIProviderChainFailover, TestAIProviderChainPrimarySuccess, TestAIProviderChainAllFail, TestAIProviderChainEmpty)
Handler tests (TestHandleAIGenerateSuccess, TestHandleAIGenerateEmptyPrompt, TestHandleAIGenerateAllProvidersFail, TestHandleAIGenerateMetrics, TestHandleAIGenerateWithContext)

requirements.description: AI input UI component in terminal workspace accepts natural language prompt, displays suggested command, and allows one-click execution into the active terminal.

AiInput component tests: module export, props interface, API contract shape, request format, structured error propagation
